name: Short Winter Stories
source:
In this game, you have traveled through distant lands to meet with the Narrator, the one who narrated and will narrate everything. So what better to do than to listen to some of her stories!

[Edited from [url=https://luis-fernando-virissimo.itch.io/short-winter-stories]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你穿越遥远的土地去见叙述者，他讲述了并将讲述一切。那么，还有什么比听听她的故事更好的呢！

[编辑自[url=https://luis-fernando-virissimo.itch.io/short-winter-stories]Itch.io[/url]]
